They were known as Ovi Rajas because they were rulers of their own territories. They were a significant tribal force in the region and played an important role in the political history of Gujarat and Rajasthan. The Ovi Rajas ruled over various territories, and one of the most famous was the Jadeja Rajput state of Rajkot. The Ovi Rajas were known for their military prowess and strategic acumen, and they provided military support to various rulers and empires in the region. They were also patrons of arts, culture, and learning.
